name: bootlace
description: Bootlace is a complete reference application integrating a single page AngularJS application with SpringMVC, Spring Security and MongoDB.
author: Mark Lee <mark.lee@capricasoftware.co.uk> (http://capricasoftware.co.uk/)

scripts.prebuild: npm run clean -s && node node_modules/mkdirp/bin/cmd.js target/assets
scripts.build:scripts: node node_modules/browserify/bin/cmd.js --debug src/main/javascript/entry.js -o target/assets/index.js && node node_modules/hashmark/bin/hashmark target/assets/index.js -l 8 -m target/assets/assets.json -s "target/assets/{name}-{hash}{ext}"
scripts.build:scripts:debug: echo Starting browserify... && node node_modules/browserify/bin/cmd.js --debug src/main/javascript/entry.js -o target/assets/index.js && echo Browserify complete, starting hashmark... && node node_modules/hashmark/bin/hashmark target/assets/index.js -l 8 -m target/assets/assets.json -s "target/assets/{name}-{hash}{ext}" && echo Build complete!
scripts.build:styles: node node_modules/cpy/cli.js node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css target/assets && node node_modules/cpy/cli.js node_modules/font-awesome/css/font-awesome.min.css target/assets && node node_modules/cpy/cli.js "node_modules/font-awesome/fonts/*" target/assets/fonts && node node_modules/cpy/cli.js node_modules/angular-toastr/dist/angular-toastr.min.css target/assets && copy "node_modules\bootswatch\cerulean\bootstrap.min.css" "target\assets\bootswatch.min.css" && node scripts/build-css.js && node node_modules/hashmark/bin/hashmark target/assets/main.css -l 8 -m target/assets/assets.json -s "target/assets/{name}-{hash}{ext}"
scripts.build: npm run build:scripts -s && npm run build:styles -s && npm run build:markup -s
scripts.build:debug: npm run build:scripts:debug && npm run build:styles && npm run build:markup
scripts.build:prod: node node_modules/browserify/bin/cmd.js src/main/javascript/entry.js -p minifyify -o target/assets/index.js && node node_modules/hashmark/bin/hashmark target/assets/index.js -l 8 -m target/assets/assets.json -s "target/assets/{name}-{hash}{ext}" && npm run build:styles -s && npm run build:markup -s
scripts.watch: node node_modules/nodemon/bin/nodemon.js -q -w src/main/javascript -w src/main/styles -w src/main/markup --ext js,css,jade --exec "npm run build"
